superAdmin.tenantSuspendDialogBody: Forces the tenant into read-only mode. Browsing remains possible, but creating / editing / deleting / suggestion engine calls are blocked at middleware with 403. Plan changes and self-cancellation remain available.

superAdmin.tenantSuspendScopeBody: Suspending increments tokenVersion for all tenant users, forcing existing sessions to be signed out on the next request. After re-login, middleware blocks write HTTP methods with 403.

superAdmin.seedDataPageDescription: Manages the sample data (management tenant's Project / Knowledge) that each tenant copies via "Starter data import". You can edit existing samples from the regular edit screens; here you toggle which items are samples (= imported). Issues/risks and retrospectives are automatically included when created under a sample project.
superAdmin.bannersPageDescription: Band messages displayed at the top of every user's screen across all tenants. They show only during the specified period (start to end) and the color reflects severity (high=red / medium=yellow / low=blue). Only one banner can be active at a time, so banners with overlapping periods cannot be created. Past banners remain as history and can be reused via "Duplicate."
